summary.intent: Complete phase 49 of a GSD workflow implementing shared folder move (intra-share) and usefolderNavigation unwrapping, then run final integration gates and verification.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed successfully. Typechecks clean, SDK 233/236 pass (3 known live-API failures), web 51/51 pass, lint clean across all packages. Verification report generated with 6/6 must-haves verified and committed.

repo: The project uses a multi-package structure with at minimum: SDK, web, and e2e packages, each with separate tsc and eslint gates.
Integration tests in `integration.test.ts` require a live local API + docker stack and are known to fail without it — these 3 failures are expected on main without docker.
The GSD workflow uses a verifier agent (sonnet) that produces a VERIFICATION.md with goal-backward REQ-N checks and a human_needed status when e2e requires docker.
Automated commits via the workflow can bypass husky pre-commit hooks, so lint must be run as a manual backstop.
The `.planning/intel/` directory contains generated API-surface hints and is not a deliverable — excluded from commits.

code.finding: REQ-5 e2e verification deferred to main-push gated live docker stack, same pattern as Phase 48.

workflow: GSD workflow runs 5 plans sequentially per phase wave, then a final integration gate (typecheck + tests) before spawning a verifier agent.
Test suites are run sequentially (SDK then web) to avoid RAM contention.
The verifier agent does goal-backward verification and emits a structured VERIFICATION.md with REQ-N must-have checks.
WARNINGs from the verifier that are UX-only with no crypto/data impact are deferred to a QA pass rather than blocking phase completion.

friction: Husky pre-commit hooks are bypassed by automated commits, requiring a manual eslint backstop step after all plans complete.
Live-API integration tests create persistent false-fail noise in the test suite (3 failures every run without docker).
The verifier status is `human_needed` due to e2e docker dependency, which may cause confusion about phase completeness.
open_items: `batchMoveItemsHandler` clears selection unconditionally instead of on-success-only because `runWrite` swallows errors — UX regression deferred to QA pass.
REQ-5 e2e test for shared folder move needs live docker stack; deferred to main-push gate.
The 3 `integration.test.ts` live-API failures remain as known tech debt requiring docker environment setup to resolve.
